notes.title: Update v1.1.0 - Ultimate Gauntlets!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I hope you've all been enjoying the game! This first major post-release update adds the Ultimate Gauntlet. This is effectively speedrunning the game without CarsOS segments. Hope to see you all on the leaderboards :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32417737/dd2fa51c3cadba42fb9480f8d606d4c58984ed84.png

Steathscape v1.1.0

 Added the Ultimate Gauntlet. Play through every Stage in the Campaign back to back, with it's own timed leaderboards!
 Gauntlet buttons are now visible when you've completed the World instead of every Stage in the World
 Fixed music not looping properly if you skipped a stage from a previous world
 Moved a few Gold Coins so they're easier to find
 Various minor changes/bug fixes


If you have any suggestions for future updates of Stealthscape, join the Discord and drop them in the #suggestions channel!

If you want to learn more about this update or future updates, visit the Stealthscape Trello or join our Discord.

notes.title: Update v1.0.1 - Stage Skipping & More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I hope you're all happy with v1.0.0! This update brings some hotfixes with 1.0.0a and two new changes in v1.0.1! 

Steathscape v1.0.0a

 The game now saves which page of the leaderboard you were looking at
 Fixed an issue with World C's CarsOS

Stealthscape v1.0.1

 You can now skip a Stage directly from the pause menu
 Your name is now blue on the leaderboards instead of the dev scores
 Final credits are now a bit more visible
 Fixed an issue with uploading a Stage with illegal characters
 Various minor changes/bug fixes


v1.1.0 will add an "Ultimate Gauntlet" which will allow you to play all 120 Stages back-to-back with one timer and it's own Leaderboards! Hope to see you all there :)

If you want to learn more about this update or future updates, visit the Stealthscape Trello or join our Discord.

notes.title: Early Access v0.6.0 Update - World G + Final Major Update!

I posted a form in the Discord regarding full release and if you've yet to check it out you can do so here!

notes.title: Early Access v0.4.0 Update - World E, New Monthly Editor Challenge, and More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this update completes World E and brings along it's post-world content! Additionally, from this update forward there will be no more "weekly" branch on Steam. Updates will still come out on a weekly basis, but they won't be separated into two different versions. Meaning you just have to stick to the main branch to get new Stages every week!

There's also a new monthly Stage Editor Challenge! The winner of last month's Challenge was spiltmilk with their Stage "Entropy"! 
This topic for this month is "Dimensions"! The topic can be interpreted in whatever way you'd like to create a fun, challenging, and/or interesting Stage. The top stages will be chosen at the end of each month to be considered for Stealthscape's official Campaign!

notes.title: Early Access v0.2.0 Update - Changelog

This update brings all the content from the previous weekly updates + WORLD C and it's Post-World Scene. I hope you guys enjoy, and for now there will be no CarsOS Replay for World C until the next weekly update as I'm running into issues with Steam Leaderboards and wanted to have this update out for you all today regardless!

 15 new stages in World C

 Controller Support
 Keyboard and controller mapping
 New accessibility options
 New "Trap" object, "Fake Walls"
 And much more from the previous weekly updates!

notes.title: v0.5.1 BETA - Enemy Update
notes.notes:
This update to Stealthscape brings back the long removed Weakling enemies along with a few new ones and some changes to previous ones. There's also been some updates to the existing campaign stages, and as a result leaderboards for some have been reset. Specifics can be found on the Trello.

v0.5.1 BETA
+"Combat" Update
..+Added Weaklings (1hp, follows when near)
..+Added Speeders (2hp, follows when hurt)
..+Added Tanks (3hp, follows when near and shoots missiles)
..+Added Torpedos (1hp, homes when player passes in front)
..-Circlers and Chargers now have 3hp
..-Shooting a Doppelganger kills the player
..-Player's fire rate has been lowered to suit these additions
+Updated Tutorial
+Stages have been updated/completely replaced
+Added Trigger (Activates a tag when player is in it's bounds)
+Added Camera (Set camera position, zoom, speed, and fx)
+Added Zoom Level in the Settings
+Added Delete Save in the Settings
-Enemies now activate buttons and pressure plates
-Your final score now shows on the end screen
-You can now play from a replay from the pause menu
-Editor Camera now stars on the player spawn
-Misc Changes + Bug Fixes

v0.5.1a BETA
-Fixed a bunch of bugs with Torpedos
-Updated the timing of the song in World A to be how it should have been

v0.5.1b BETA
+Added more Customization options
+Redid the crosshairs and added new ones
-Version number is now located in the settings
-Tanks no longer move
-Zooming no longer looks weird
-Other misc bugfixes


Visit the Trello for more on this update and future updates!
https://trello.com/b/h69qJjRQ/stealthscape
